case_title: MERCEDES TAYLOR VS. VANGUARD PROPERTY MANAGEMENT

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,000.00 FILED BY TAYLOR, MERCEDES AS TO DEFENDANT VANGUARD PROPERTY MANAGEMENT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-18-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION RE: REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM (SMALL CLAIMS) (HEARING SET FOR FEB-18-2021 AT 10:00AM) FILED BY PLAINTIFF TAYLOR, MERCEDES
REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM (SMALL CLAIMS) (HEARING: FEB-18-2021 AT 10:00AM);(REQUEST FORWARDED TO DEPT 506 FOR JUDICIAL REVIEW & SIGNATURE.) FILED BY PLAINTIFF TAYLOR, MERCEDES
ORDER ON REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY ZOOM. THE REQUEST IS GRANTED. [HEARING SET FOR FEB-18-22 AT 10:00AM]

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-18-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-01-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF MERCEDES TAYLOR IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT VANGUARD PROPERTY MANAGEMENT IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY CRAIG WADDLE, CEO. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $2028 TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE APRIL 1ST HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE AND PUNITIVE REWARD WILL BE CONSIDERED. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO DISMISS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT VANGUARD PROPERTY MANAGEMENT
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
